details.description: chat-latest is OpenAI's rolling alias for the Instant-tier model currently used in ChatGPT's default chat experience; the underlying snapshot is updated regularly rather than being a fixed dated release. It is offered directly by OpenAI and, as gpt-chat-latest, through Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry, where it currently carries a preview label. It accepts text and image input and produces text output, and supports reasoning, function calling, structured outputs and tools such as web search, file search, image generation and a code interpreter, but not the computer-use tool. OpenAI's own documentation recommends GPT-6 Astra instead for production API usage.
advantages: Supports reasoning together with function calling, structured outputs, web search, file search, image generation and a code interpreter tool (OpenAI chat-latest model page; Microsoft Foundry models page).
Azure's gpt-chat-latest snapshot (2026-08-06) lists training data current through February 2026 (Microsoft Foundry models page).
Offered on both OpenAI's own API and Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry (OpenAI chat-latest model page; Microsoft Foundry models page).
disadvantages: OpenAI's own documentation recommends GPT-6 Astra rather than chat-latest for production API usage (OpenAI chat-latest model page).
Listed as a Preview model on Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry, so it does not follow Azure's standard GA retirement lifecycle (Microsoft Foundry models page).
Does not support the computer-use tool (OpenAI chat-latest model page).
use_cases: General-purpose conversational chat matching ChatGPT's default Instant-tier behavior
Tool-using agents that need function calling, web search or file search
Combined image-and-text tasks using vision input
Coding assistance via the code interpreter tool

sources.title: Foundry Models sold by Azure - Microsoft Foundry | Microsoft Learn
Model retirement schedule - Microsoft Foundry | Microsoft Learn

notes: Azure hosts this model as gpt-chat-latest (preview) while OpenAI's own API uses the unversioned alias chat-latest; both point to the same rolling Instant-tier snapshot, matching this target's grouping of azure/chat-latest and openai/chat-latest. The catalog's max_input_tokens [272000, 400000] and max_output_tokens [128000] match the newest Azure snapshot (400,000 context = 272,000 input + 128,000 output) and OpenAI's own page. Confirmed the catalog's 2026-12-02 deprecation_date against Azure's Model retirement schedule, which lists gpt-chat-latest (2026-08-06, Preview) with a 2026-12-02 retirement date.
